description: Diorama (50x50): a river valley between forested level-2 to level-6 terraces; Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites on the south-east level-4 bench and the east level-6 terrace, the Deep Processor and the sandstone quarry on the central level-3 strip, five record caches around the Archive Excavation at the south edge.

unmet.reason: No Deep Ore Vein can stand under a Deep Mine site: the flat dry 10x11 mine footprint fits at only 26 positions (levels 3 and 4, all in the southern forest), and every one has 16 to 24 trees on the 5x5 vein cells under its ground core; a vein is placed only on tree-free ground (native BlockValidator, as the map editor places it).

Only one quarry fits: a seam needs a tree-free flat 5x5 under the 11x7 quarry core, which exists at 12 quarry positions, all in the central level-3 strip (x20-28, y12-32), and every two of them overlap. The Sandstone Quarry takes it (one of each building needs 12,607 sandstone and 10,806 limestone); the three limestone outcrops (1,800) remain.

No flat dry 20x15 footprint at any level: no level has a flat dry rectangle 15 wide and 15 tall (15 tall, the widest is 9 on levels 3 and 4); the largest flat dry rectangles are 7x29 (level 3), 6x26 (level 4) and 9x11 (level 6), the largest square 11x11 (level 3).
No flat dry 12x12 footprint at any level: the largest flat dry square is 11x11 (level 3); 12 tall, the widest flat dry rectangle is 10 (levels 3 and 4).
No flat dry 12x11 footprint at any level: 12 wide, flat dry rectangles reach at most 9 tall (level 3); 11 tall, at most 11 wide (level 3).
No flat dry 12x11 footprint at any level: 12 wide, flat dry rectangles reach at most 9 tall (level 3); 11 tall, at most 11 wide (level 3).
No flat dry 12x11 footprint at any level: 12 wide, flat dry rectangles reach at most 9 tall (level 3); 11 tall, at most 11 wide (level 3).
No flat dry 12x11 footprint at any level: 12 wide, flat dry rectangles reach at most 9 tall (level 3); 11 tall, at most 11 wide (level 3).

The 12x10 footprint fits at only 11 positions, all in the south level-3 pocket (x19-30, y0-13), which holds the Deep Processor (the only building that turns DeepOre into coal, oil, uranium and alloy).
The 12x10 footprint fits at only 11 positions, all in the south level-3 pocket (x19-30, y0-13), which holds the Deep Processor; without a launch pad site the rocket program cannot run here anyway.
The 11x10 footprint fits at only 23 positions, all in the two south pockets (level 3 x19-30 y0-13, level 4 x32-42 y0-13); they hold the Deep Processor and the Archive Excavation with its five caches.
The 12x9 footprint fits at only 36 positions, all in the two south pockets (level 3 x19-30 y0-17, level 4 x32-41 y0-15); they hold the Deep Processor, the Archive Excavation and a Deep Drill site.

The 11x9 footprint fits at only 51 positions: the two south pockets and the level-6 terrace (x41-49, y14-24); those hold both Deep Drill sites (the only places a drill fits), the Deep Processor and the Archive Excavation.
The 9x10 footprint fits at 103 positions, all in the two south pockets and on the level-6 terrace, which hold both Deep Drill sites, the Deep Processor and the Archive Excavation.
